text: それ　あずけたら　こまるん　ちゃう？

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら after a verb means 'if' or 'when that is done'. あずけたら = 'if you deposit'.

patterns.name: 〜ではない (ちゃう)
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is Kansai dialect for じゃない. With a rising tone it asks 'isn't it so?'. こまるんちゃう？ = 'wouldn't that be trouble?'.
